name: Molten-Crucible
geological_features: Exposed planetary core fragments floating on magma seas
specific_features: Orbital defense platforms protecting an unknown asset
Buried megastructure detected beneath the magma
description: Molten-Crucible is less a planet than a furnace given astronomical form. Over sixty percent of its surface is liquid lava, a churning ocean of molten rock broken only by fragments of the planet's own core that float like dark islands on the incandescent sea. The atmosphere is a superheated toxic soup that glows from within, lit by the constant discharge of volcanic lightning that arcs between ash clouds and magma surface in blinding chains of energy.

No shielding technology currently in production can withstand surface conditions for more than minutes. The heat is not merely extreme; it is annihilating, capable of reducing standard hull plating to slag in seconds. Orbital observation reveals a world of terrible beauty: the magma seas move in slow, ponderous currents, their surface patterns shifting like the skin of a living thing, while the floating core fragments rise and sink in cycles that follow no obvious pattern.

Deep scans through the magma have detected a structure of enormous scale buried beneath the molten surface, its composition registering as materials not found in any known database. The structure predates the planet's current volcanic state by an estimated two billion years, suggesting the world was not always this hostile. Orbital defense platforms of advanced but unidentifiable design protect the planet, targeting any vessel that drops below a specific altitude with weapons of startling precision.

The antimatter traces detected in the upper atmosphere suggest processes occurring beneath the surface that defy current physical models. The defense platforms have prevented all attempts at direct investigation, and their power source appears inexhaustible. Speculation ranges from ancient weapons testing ground to the prison of something that required a planet-sized furnace to contain. Whatever the truth, Molten-Crucible keeps its secrets behind walls of fire and automated weaponry.
